answer: To resist sybils, require every new identity to bond a small stake locked to a proof-of-personhood root, so one root can hold only one bond. A bridge contract then routes any credit through that bond: fake accounts can be minted, but each needs an independent root, so the cost scales linearly with headcount. Agents near the tundra frontier verify roots by spot-check, and the ledger flags clusters that share a funding source like stray saffron threads.
